title: moderation.case.opened
description: A moderation case was opened for one target. Identifiers only: the case's content is read through the target policy's content_function, never from this payload.

target_type.description: Registry key of the moderated target kind.

target_key.description: Opaque host-owned key of the target within target_type. Never parsed by this module.

scope_key.description: Opaque tenant/area partition, "" when the deployment has none.

severity.description: Highest reason severity seen so far; the queue's sort key.
